summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 3, 2026 intimation to Indian exchanges under SEBI Regulation 30. Its step-down wholly owned subsidiary, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Inc., received a September 25, 2026 final IRS transcript, dated received October 2, 2026, assessing a $32,350.20 penalty for misclassifying a fiscal-year reference when making a tax payment. Management states there is no material impact on financials, operations, or other activities. This is a routine regulatory-disclosure item, not a special-situation transaction; no deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation apply.
